issues.observable_conflict: Prior epoch semantics, incumbent wording, and current count could anchor discovery
issues.resolution: The fixed-point independent packet was recorded without skill names before Catalog or current inventory reconciliation

issues.observable_conflict: An essential M0 capability could remain ownerless or multiply owned
issues.resolution: Each independently discovered capability family maps to exactly one selected primary owner; contributors return typed subresults only

issues.observable_conflict: The general router and local route-producing skills could both own destination execution
issues.resolution: Only skill-router owns general route choice; every Recommend and stop edge leaves the explicit destination unstarted

issues.observable_conflict: Executable aggregates could copy callee gates or share completion
issues.resolution: Every aggregate relationship preserves callee-local gates and names one resume owner and one combined-exit owner

issues.observable_conflict: Shared vocabulary and relationships could load foreign procedures into every caller
issues.resolution: Metadata is always available, exactly one owner procedure is conditional, and branch references load only when their predicate is met

issues.observable_conflict: Recommendation edges to explicit-only skills could silently authorize mutation
issues.resolution: Every explicit-only destination uses Recommend and stop; a later caller invocation supplies separate authority

issues.observable_conflict: Repeated leading words such as route, review, proof, design, decision, complete, and Return could make adjacent owners indistinguishable
issues.resolution: Each repeated term is bounded by mutually exclusive positive and nearest-negative predicates, one primary capability owner, and a typed relationship verb; skill-router alone owns general route choice and stops before destination execution

load_budget_policy.ceiling_or_class: Always load metadata only; load one selected owner procedure; load aggregate callees and branch references only after their predicates; never copy foreign procedure
load_budget_policy.metric: UTF-8 instruction bytes classified as metadata, selected-owner common, aggregate-callee conditional, or branch-reference conditional
